text-dominant.rationale: Fact recall, dynamic update, memory boundary, temporal, knowledge, and conflict questions are primarily text-memory tasks.

visual-dominant.rationale: Visual fact recall, visual search, and visual update explicitly require visual evidence.

cross-modal.rationale: Cross-modal reasoning and test-time learning connect information across text and images.

plot_data.primary_denominator: available evidence opportunities for that evidence form
plot_data.error_bar_note: Population standard deviation across eligible WMA QA items. The reference figure averages three benchmarks; this file contains one benchmark only.

query_types.mapping_rationale: Fact recall, dynamic update, memory boundary, temporal, knowledge, and conflict questions are primarily text-memory tasks.
Visual fact recall, visual search, and visual update explicitly require visual evidence.
Cross-modal reasoning and test-time learning connect information across text and images.

plot_data.reference_figure_error_bar: computed in the cross-benchmark aggregate file as population std across benchmarks

definitions.selected_count: Number of retrieved MAUs whose deterministic PPO action selected the evidence form.
definitions.available_count: Number of retrieved MAUs for which EvidenceChainBuilder marked the evidence form available.
definitions.selection_rate_over_all_top7_percent: 100 * selected_count / all retrieved Top-7 MAUs, including unavailable opportunities.
definitions.per_query_available_rate: For each eligible QA, 100 * selected MAUs / available MAUs; mean and population standard deviation are reported.
